decision: Accept the validated Anatomed paper context into project knowledge-state version 2.
boundaries: The accepted paper context is bounded, project-local context and is not authoritative over the manuscript, benchmark records, source code, or later owner decisions.
Paper claims must not be treated as proof of code implementation, universal anatomical correctness, learning benefit, patient safety, or live synchronization.
No claim scope may exceed the validated research run, accepted input set, pinned context descriptor, and context note.
repository_revision_convention: project.repository_revision is SHA-256 of the lowercase 40-character clean approved base Git HEAD, encoded with no trailing newline.
